title: Convenient change can still feel binding
meaning: Revising actions to combine different needs can coexist with an emotional attachment in which convenience does not amount to freedom.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of this Energy Field describes changing shared actions under new conditions. Temperance in energy motivates you to find a combination of needs and recognise different rhythms. The Devil in emotions adds the experience of a powerful attachment, where pleasure can coexist with restricted freedom. Even a successfully revised arrangement may therefore remain emotionally constricting: participation becomes easier, while someone still finds it difficult to imagine the right not to participate at all.

For example, you change the time of an evening game so that one person can finish their tasks and the other need not stay up late. The new hour works, and the shared interest is enjoyable. Yet wanting to spend one evening separately brings guilt. **We have found a convenient time, but I still struggle to decline freely.** It becomes noticeable that practical accommodation and emotional attachment concern different aspects of the same occasion.

Tension increases if the convenience achieved becomes an argument against any refusal: surely the arrangement now suits everyone. Accommodation then turns into a more carefully organised way of retaining a habit. The Devil does not simply mean a vivid interest here; difficulty in choosing freely is essential. Temperance as motivation likewise does not establish that the chosen middle ground has removed every restriction or feels the same to both people.
